1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.Bb5+ Bd7 4.Bxd7+ Qxd7.strategy: Prepares the broad pawn centre that White has been aiming for since the bishop trade. The price is that it takes c3 from the b1-knight and e4 still has no defender, so White needs one as soon as Black's knight comes out.

Develops with tempo: the knight attacks the undefended e4, so White must spend a move protecting it before the pawn centre can be completed. Black stands solidly with an equal game and contests the centre by piece play.
